intelligence_evolution.summary: The DRIP leg opened via a $36 JEPQ reallocation (0%→24%), putting the book at a near-target 26/50/24 mix. Then a 6-day automation outage (07-01→07-06) left the account unmanaged and forced this After-Hours to run on a 6-day-stale matrix in SAFE MODE. Reconciliation stayed clean (7/7) and every LAB stop held through the holiday-week pullback.
intelligence_evolution.key_insight: The strategy is sound but the plumbing is not: the account's real risk this phase was not a bad trade, it was going 6 days with no engine and no session. The safety guards (staleness → SAFE MODE, fractional between-session monitor) did their job, but they only cap risk — they cannot compound. Fixing engine + session scheduling is the highest-leverage work.
